resources.string: Key pin is past the shear line. Ease the wrench and it slips back.
Left thumb: pull down. Right thumb: find a pin and lift.
The binding pin is seized. Ease the wrench until it moves.
Keep the pick on pin %1$d and ease the wrench. The plug has to turn back.
A serration on pin %1$d has caught. It is not set: ease the wrench and keep lifting.
The plug is hanging on pin %1$d\'s spool. Lift it and ease the wrench.
Pin %1$d is binding. Slide the pick under it and lift.
Clean pick: no drops, oversets or seizes.
Three stars: clean and under %1$d s.
Or tap the shackle for the next lock.
Locksport is picking locks as a puzzle. Only pick a lock you own or have been asked to pick, and never one that is in use.

The plug is the cylinder that turns, with the keyway cut in it. The housing around it holds still. Each column is a pin stack in its chamber: a key pin at the bottom, a driver pin above it, and a spring pushing both down. Turn on EXPLODED or GHOST to see them all.

The shear line is the gap between the plug and the housing. A driver that crosses it pins the plug to the housing. The right key lifts every stack until the split between key pin and driver sits exactly on the line, and the plug turns. The SHEAR camera looks straight at it.

No lock is made perfectly. Turn the plug a little and one driver catches on its chamber before the others: that is the binding pin. Lift it to the shear line and it sets; the plug creeps round and the next pin binds. The needle on the WRENCH dial shows the creep.

The wrench turns the plug. Too little and set pins fall back. Too much and the binding pin seizes and will not lift. Let go and every pin drops. Lift a pin too far and its key pin crosses the line instead: it oversets. Ease off and it drops back.

A spool driver is thin in the middle. Its waist can sit on the shear line and let the plug turn far: a false set. Keep lifting the spool and ease the wrench until the plug turns back a little (counter-rotation), and it sets.
A serrated driver has fine grooves, and each one clicks on the shear line like a set that is not one. Pull hard and a groove catches. Keep the tension light and lift through the clicks.
The full primer, with a glossary, is docs/LOCKSPORT.md in the project.
Tension zone. Hold anywhere and pull down to put torque on the plug. Letting go drops every pin.
Pick pad. Slide across to move the pick along the keyway and slide up to lift its tip. Tap a column to lift that pin to the shear line.
